question: How many cars are in the parking lot at the top left of the picture?

changes.detail: Copy the complete counted referent into SELECT_SEM MULTI before authoritative COUNT; remove premature crop.
changes.query: the cars in the parking lot at the top left of the picture

reviews.reason: 仅 REGION 方位裁剪后直接 COUNT，同一区域内的目标没有按题目所说停车场/道路/海岸/围栏水域/草地或同类并列条件进一步限制；粗方位不等于所指具体区域，程序语义会扩大计数集合。
reviews.question: How many cars are in the parking lot at the top left of the picture?
choices: (E) This image doesn't feature the count.
reviews.review_scope: text-only logical plan; no images or source answers read
reviews.corrected_dsl:
INTENT(RELATIONAL_COUNT)
n1=LOCATE($image0,T("car"))
n2=SELECT_SEM($n1,null,"all cars are in the parking lot at the top left of the picture",MULTI,$image0)
n3=COUNT_ENTITIES($n2,T("car"),false)
FINAL($n3,CHOICE_SINGLE)

question: How many boats are docked in the water on the top right?

reviews.reason: COUNT.entities 直接返回候选集合长度，不消费 params.target 的颜色/状态；当前候选来源未施加 COUNT 独有的属性，因而会把不满足条件的目标计入。
reviews.question: How many boats are docked in the water on the top right?
choices: (E) This image doesn't feature the count.

INTENT(RELATIONAL_COUNT)
n1=REGION($image0,TOP_RIGHT)
n2=LOCATE($n1,T("water"))
n3=LOCATE($n1,T("boat"))
n4=SELECT_REL($n3,$n2,INSIDE)
n5=COUNT_ENTITIES($n4,T("boat",state="docked"),false)

question: How many ships are there in the second row of docks from the left?

reviews.reason: 生产 GROUP(COLUMN) 返回带 group_id 的原 dock 实体，SELECT_ORD(...,2,LEFT_TO_RIGHT) 实际选第二个 dock，不是第二排 docks；随后 COUNT_IMAGE 因而在单 dock 区域计数。改为船候选级 SEM 完整行序描述，再 COUNT_ENTITIES，保留“第二排码头从左”的题意且不修改运行时。
reviews.question: How many ships are there in the second row of docks from the left?
reviews.original_dsl:
n1=LOCATE($image0,T("dock"))
n2=GROUP($n1,COLUMN)
n3=SELECT_ORD($n2,null,2,LEFT_TO_RIGHT)
n4=SELECT_SUBREGION($n3,null,INSIDE)
n5=COUNT_IMAGE($n4,T("ship"),false)
FINAL($n5,CHOICE_SINGLE)

question: What is the shortest route from the road to the right of the longest blue rectangular building, located slightly above the center of the image, to the intersection above the nearest lake to the top left corner of the building?

reviews.question: What is the shortest route from the road to the right of the longest blue rectangular building, located slightly above the center of the image, to the intersection above the nearest lake to the top left corner of the building?
reviews.original_dsl:
INTENT(ROUTE_PLANNING)
n1=LOCATE($image0,T("building",color="blue",shape="rectangular"))
n2=SELECT_SEM($n1,null,"the longest blue rectangular building located slightly above the center of the image",SINGLE,$image0)
n3=LOCATE($image0,T("road"))
n4=SELECT_REL($n3,$n2,RIGHT_OF)
n5=LOCATE($image0,T("lake"))
n6=SELECT_REL($n5,$n2,NEAR)
n7=LOCATE($image0,T("intersection"))
n8=SELECT_REL($n7,$n6,ABOVE)
n9=BUILD_ROUTE_CONTEXT($image0,$n4,$n8)
FINAL_QUESTION($n9,CHOICE_SINGLE,"Which option describes the shortest route between the selected start and goal?")
